overview: In its inaugural meeting, the Medford Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board reviewed statutory trust powers and local housing data, established regular meeting times, and discussed board officer roles. Trustees also discussed forming working groups for governance and preparing an application for $250,000 in Community Preservation Act funds.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust Overview and Housing Data Presentation
items.summary: Housing Planner Aditi Moogoor presented an overview of the trust's legal powers and functions as a municipal bank, alongside Medford demographic, cost-burden, and housing inventory data.

items.title: Trustee and Staff Introductions
items.summary: Trustees and municipal staff introduced themselves and outlined their relevant professional backgrounds and civic interests in affordable housing.

items.title: Meeting Schedule and Officer Roles
items.summary: The board scheduled its regular monthly meetings for the first Wednesday of each month and reviewed duties for designating a chair, vice chair, treasurer, and clerk at a subsequent meeting.

items.title: Establishment of Working Groups
items.summary: The board reviewed proposals to establish two trustee working groups to draft a Declaration of Trust and to develop a two-year strategic action plan.

items.title: Finances and CPA Funding Application
items.summary: The board reviewed Community Preservation Act funding rules, discussed an initial application requesting $250,000 in CPA funds to seed the trust, and debated eligible expenditures including studies and parcel reviews.
